provenance.sourceAccessMethod: Retained HTML, source register, direct public-page text and decoded public JSON only. Local authoring performed no network requests or authenticated interactions.
provenance.originalResearchAccessLimitations: Original source register discloses an early managed-browser fallback whose clean-session status could not be established. It was stopped; core findings were reread through unauthenticated HTTP. Later browser checks used an isolated temporary context. OneMap records sometimes included a token warning alongside populated public coordinate data; no credentials were supplied. These coordinates establish orientation estimates, not certified admission bands.
provenance.publicationDates: Original artifact creation/publication dates and original model are unknown. Source page publication/update dates, where retained, are distinct from retrieval dates. No publication date for this guide is assigned.

datePolicy: Research was retained on November 6–7, 2026 Singapore time. Cited pages with source-specific retained retrieval records use November 7, 2026; Annex A and OneMap distance service have no independently established source-specific access day and are marked unknown. Localization is not a research refresh. Exact 2027 phase dates are not announced in the retained material; no earlier dates are relabelled. Expected cohort is an annual-rule inference, not a newly published calendar. Only 2025 school-level figures are verified; no current-year school table is implied.
uncertainties: Exact 2027 phase dates, 2027 PR-cap list and phase-specific PR limits are unconfirmed. Do not carry previous dates or caps forward.

The expected January 2, 2021–January 1, 2022 cohort is inferred from the prior annual boundary. A January 1, 2021 birthday falls in the earlier cohort; confirm the actual birthday and exercise instructions.
All SC groups precede PR groups. Two-track Phase 2C changes distance priority, not citizenship priority. Reserved places are not PR-reserved places.

Only 2025 Phase 2C and Supplementary school figures were verified. 2024 and 2026 school counts and all school-level Phase 3 figures were not recovered. No ballot is not proof every applicant was admitted; totals are not PR availability or admission probability.

No verified six-to-eight-school suitable shortlist within about 2 km of one Beauty World address. Eight comparison rows include six co-ed schools across a wider area and two girls-only schools ineligible for the scenario son.

Orientation distances use a public MRT point and retained school coordinates, not a real condo or MOE-certified HSD. Bukit View old-campus distance is not applicable to its announced new campus for the 2027 exercise; new-campus distance remains unknown.

Distance-priority ordinary-address residence minimum begins at exercise start, not submission or school entry. Same-HSD moves can continue fulfilling it; beyond-category moves can trigger MOE-directed transfer. New two-track implementation and purchased-property routes need their own applicable instructions.
No newer primary fee schedule was confirmed. 2026 PR S$343/month and twelve-payment S$4,116 are dated baseline arithmetic, not 2028 charges. Meals, uniforms, books, transport and care are extra.

Authenticated declarations were not inspected. An extra PR-specific P1 NS or fee undertaking was not established, not proven absent. Parent-sponsored male PR NS obligations are separate; scenario sponsorship route is unknown.
No source refresh, school contact, application, publication, source-run edits or website-repository changes occurred in this authoring task.
editingContract: Complete English and Simplified Chinese guides; same factual numeric/date/URL multiplicities and corresponding table structures. Only the two assigned Markdown files and shared semantic JSON are authored. Existing stage2-relative guide and source-note locators are retained for parent rebasing; no build or shared inventory edit. No ratings, stars or review markup.
